narrative.intro: Tutor Perini has $252M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, spread across 13 awards with an average award size of $19.4M. Obligations are up 745.8% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security is the dominant buyer, accounting for $248M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the dominant market at $252M. Fiscal-year obligations show volatility: FY21 recorded $127M, FY22 recorded $222M, FY23 recorded $87.4M, FY24 recorded $68.3M, and FY25 recorded $29.8M. Smaller flows go to the Department of the Interior at $1.6M, the Department of Defense at $1.5M, and the General Services Administration at $650K. Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction is a small market at $10K. Current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date, and the figures shown are contract obligations except where table notes state award-value figures are total contract values. This profile summarizes where Tutor Perini is concentrated and how current-year activity compares with recent fiscal years.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Tutor Perini's FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Department of Homeland Security leads obligations with $248M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $252M. The Department of the Interior, the Department of Defense, and the General Services Administration account for much smaller shares at $1.6M, $1.5M, and $650K respectively.

sections.heading: How do FY2026 obligations compare with prior years?
sections.body: FY2026 obligations total $252M, which follows FY25 obligations of $29.8M and FY24 obligations of $68.3M. Prior years show FY23 at $87.4M, FY22 at $222M, and FY21 at $127M, indicating variability across fiscal years.

faq.q: How much does Tutor Perini make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Tutor Perini has $252M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company has 13 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $19.4M and obligations that are up 745.8% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Tutor Perini?
faq.a: Department of Homeland Security buys the most from Tutor Perini, with $248M in obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior, the Department of Defense, and the General Services Administration follow with $1.6M, $1.5M, and $650K respectively.

faq.q: What does Tutor Perini sell to the government?
faq.a: Tutor Perini sells work in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction and in Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $252M and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $10K in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: Which Tutor Perini contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: No expiring-contract items are listed in the provided figures. The available tables and figures show obligations, award counts, markets, and top buying agencies but do not list expiring contracts.
